# Quantiify

> Quantiify is AI-assisted construction takeoff and estimation software by Conneqted Agents. It reads PDF and CAD drawings, detects and counts symbols, measures lengths and areas, and turns reviewed quantities into priced estimates and BOQs. Estimators stay in control: every AI result is reviewed, edited and approved before it is used.

Trades: Electrification; Sanitary & plumbing; Electromechanical; Structural & finishing.
Workflow: Project setup, Upload, AI legend detection, Symbol count, Cable takeoff, Estimate, Export (Excel, CSV, PDF).

## Plans
- Free: $0/month. Explore Quantiify and test AI-assisted workflows before scaling.
- Basic (Team): $299/month. Perfect for individual estimators and small contractor teams.
- Enterprise: $899/month. Built for growing organizations managing multiple projects and trades.

## FAQ
**Can I use Quantiify if my estimating process still requires manual takeoff?**
Yes. Quantiify supports manual, AI-assisted, and hybrid takeoff workflows. Your estimator can review, edit, override, or complete quantities rather than being forced to accept an automated result.

**How does Quantiify handle projects with multiple sheets and document types?**
Quantiify is designed to work with project document sets, not just isolated drawings. Your documents can be organized and processed together so the relevant sheets and information are available throughout the takeoff workflow.

**Can Quantiify support different estimating logic for different trades?**
Yes. Quantiify supports trade-aware workflows where components, measurement methods, calculations, review steps, and structured outputs can be aligned with electrical, mechanical, architectural, and civil estimating requirements.

**Can multiple estimators or quantity surveyors collaborate on the same project?**
Yes. Team plans support multiple users within the estimating workflow, allowing project work, quantity review, and approval processes to be managed across the team according to the selected plan.

**Which drawing and document formats does Quantiify support?**
Quantiify supports project drawing sets in approved PDF and CAD formats.

**Can Quantiify generate BOQ-ready outputs for pricing and tender preparation?**
Quantiify can turn reviewed quantities into structured BOQ outputs that can support pricing, reporting, and downstream tender or estimating workflows. The estimator or quantity surveyor remains responsible for reviewing and approving the final information.
